name: AEM-Driven Quality Improvement for Aristotle Mathematical Research

description: Exp 12: AEM 5-pillar prompt engineering for Aristotle. Enhanced all prompts Aristotle receives with AEM quality directives. DIRECTION prompt now scores concepts on 5 AEM pillars + bonus for balanced scores. PROMPT_WRITING system prompt includes AEM Quality Mandate (Rigor, Aesthetic, Utility, Originality, Impact). Aristotle's direct prompt now includes full AEM QUALITY SCORING section with pillar-by-pillar guidelines. Enrichment prompts include AEM targets. Quality evaluator returns AEM pillar scores. Baseline catalog AEM: 27.86/50 (R=7.15 A=5.52 U=5.00 O=4.18 I=6.01).

asi.changes: 6 prompt engineering enhancements across all Aristotle-facing prompts: (1) DIRECTION system prompt - AEM 5-pillar breakthrough scoring + AEM bonus priority, (2) PROMPT_WRITING system prompt - AEM Quality Mandate with all 5 pillars, (3) DIRECT Aristotle prompt - full AEM QUALITY SCORING section with pillar-by-pillar guidelines, (4) Enrichment prompts - AEM targets (no sorries, 10+ theorems, 2+ domains, novel defs, bounds, physics/crypto/ML keywords), (5) Quality evaluator - aem_rigor/aesthetic/utility/originality/impact in response format, (6) Fallback quality evaluation - AEM evaluator heuristics for offline assessment
